snippet.title: The Maverick Hunter Chronicles TRAILER - Release date (DOOM WAD)
snippet.description:
LINK TO DOWNLOAD: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/156589-tc-the-maverick-hunter-chronicles-v1release-a-mega-man-x-inspired-wad/

After years of experimenting with DOOM map editors, I present the first trailer for my WAD project. 

You are Rockiie, a rookie Maverick Hunter, and you are on your first field mission when things go wrong and all the Reploids go crazy.

It's your mission to confront the Maverick forces that threaten the city's safety, but as you progress, you'll question things about your own nature. 

The first version will be released on Christmas 2025, with more updates at: 
https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/152367-the-maverick-hunter-chronicles-some-screenshots-of-the-project-in-progress/?tab=comments#comment-2946033 


SONG OF TRAILER: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers - Area 4 Building(Mega Man X3 Remix) / PrincessZelda2020 https://youtu.be/ZTIWTE-Ph50?si=6vmv0wzOfghYWVT5


Sígueme en mis redes sociales!!!
